causal.assumptions_right: The cash-versus-strip gap was real; CAD policy was easier than the 2027 contract.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: Ownership and holding period. Other desks already received CAD. A sub-day hold cannot harvest a multi-quarter easing gap, and the bid was crowded before entry.
causal.causal_divergence: Zero result was not a one-day falsification of CAD easing versus 3.40. Price did not pay the late receiver because the receive was already owned.
causal.future_implication: Do not receive CORRA Mar27 while other desks are crowded received. Cash 2.30 versus 3.125 is not permission to join.
causal.observed_reality: Flat scratch in under a day: entry 3.40, exit 3.40. The freeze now shows Mar27 at 3.125 versus CORRA cash 2.30 with the receive crowded on other desks.
causal.original_belief: Long/receive CORRA Mar27 at 3.40 was a cheap policy-path receive versus easier CAD cash, with room for the 2027 strip to rally.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: With crowding known, the receive would not have been opened for a same-session hold; the book would have stayed flat.

items.expression_assessment: Outright CORRA Mar27 receive was the consensus expression; better ownership was elsewhere or flat.
items.future_rule: No new receive on CORRA 2027-03 while crowding is flagged, regardless of cash-strip cheapness; if the hold cannot extend beyond one session, do not enter.
items.lesson: Cheap versus cash is not an entry when the receive is already the crowded desk position.
items.timing_assessment: Sub-day scratch was an entry into an already-owned bid, not a timed harvest.
items.what_failed: Opened a crowded CAD receive with no ownership edge and no holding period long enough to monetize the cash-strip gap.

causal.assumptions_right: Paying the less-crowded AUD path had ownership edge relative to CAD receive; a short window was enough to clip 2bp.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: A 2bp two-session gain is not proof the RBA hike cycle was harvested as a structural thesis; path and tenor beyond Mar27 were not required for the result.
causal.causal_divergence: Result matched the anti-crowd pay, then stopped. It did not demonstrate that scaling AUD pays, or recycling CAD, was licensed.
causal.future_implication: Keep preferring unowned AUD pay over crowded CAD receive when expansion is allowed; do not read a 2bp clip as a green light to reopen either leg.
causal.observed_reality: Brief pay worked: entry 4.86, exit 4.88 over two sessions. The freeze now shows AONIA cash 4.35 versus Jun27 5.005.
causal.original_belief: Short/pay AONIA Mar27 at 4.86 was the less-owned hike-path expression versus a crowded CAD receive.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: The pay would still have been the correct side versus crowded CORRA receive; it would not have been treated as confirmation to re-enter CAD or to enlarge AONIA.

items.no_new_lesson: Bounded ordinary variance around a sound anti-crowd pay; process remains sound. Do not overfit a two-session 2bp win into a new rule beyond keep fading crowded CAD receive.
items.sizing_assessment: Size produced a small 2bp clip without turning a brief timing window into a concentrated structural bet.
items.thesis_assessment: Anti-crowd pay versus crowded CAD receive was the right ownership lens; the clip was too small to call the structural hike path complete.
items.what_worked: Paid a less-owned AONIA Mar27 expression and exited after a small, timely 2bp move rather than joining CAD receive.
